title: Iki lab list (iki/v1)
description: A list the lab curates (ADR 0270, ADR 0295), such as purification methods or deviation categories: a field that refers to it, `{ type: ref, to: PurificationMethod }`, is a dropdown of its options. Each option is a registry entry, identified by its `code`, with a `label`, a `description` and a place in the list's order, which its registry's registrars and list curators change, each with a reason; every project in the registry picks from it. Only descriptive vocabulary is a list: a value a guard, state, rule, signature or calculation reads stays an `enum`.

apiVersion.description: The spec version this manifest follows.

name.description: The list's name in PascalCase, such as `PurificationMethod`. Elsewhere it is `plugin.Name`, and a field refers to it by it.

label.description: What people call one of its options, such as `Purification method`. Defaults to the name split into words.

label_plural.description: What people see for the list, such as `Sample matrices`. Defaults to the label with an `s`.

schema_version.description: Increase it whenever the fields change. Other plugins' dependencies and actions name the versions they work with.

fields.description: Its options' facts besides their `code`, `label`, `description` and `position`, by name, such as a method's SOP. Each is a registry fact its curators give; a reference names another list.

options.description: The options each registry starts with, in the order the list shows them. Installing the plugin adds them to every registry, and a registry made later gets them too; an upgrade adds those a registry hasn't got, by code, at the end of its list, and never changes, reorders or restores the options a registry has. Without it, the list starts empty.

option.description: A starting option: its code and label, and values for the list's other fields, by name. A reference to another list's option names it by its code.

code.description: Its identity in the list, which never changes, such as `hplc`: what exports and the API give for it, and what an upgrade finds it by. A wrong one is superseded, never changed.

label.description: What people see and pick, such as `HPLC purification`: one line, unique in the list. Curators can change it, with a reason.

description.description: What it means, or when to choose it, shown beside it.

fact.description: One of the options' facts: a field as a type has, with only what a registry fact can be. Its curators give it; with `immutable: true` it's fixed once the option is added (ADR 0143), and a wrong one is superseded.

type.description: The kind of value: a fact is never a state, a person, free text, JSON or a file.
